summary:
**HABITAT ZERO – Design. Survive. Investigate.**

HABITAT ZERO is a browser-based space exploration and survival game designed to introduce players to the challenges of establishing a sustainable human habitat beyond Earth. Players take on the role of junior astronauts, making decisions, managing resources, designing habitats, and completing missions to survive in an unfamiliar space environment.

The project combines interactive storytelling and gameplay with real-world space science, incorporating NASA data and resources to make the experience more informative and engaging. Instead of simply reading about space exploration, players learn by making decisions and experiencing the consequences of their actions.

HABITAT ZERO addresses the challenge of making space science more accessible and engaging, particularly for younger audiences. It highlights the importance of resource management, scientific thinking, problem-solving, and sustainable habitat design—skills that are essential for humanity's future exploration of space.
details:
HABITAT ZERO – Design. Survive. Investigate.

HABITAT ZERO is an interactive, browser-based space habitat simulation game designed to introduce students and young learners to the challenges of establishing and maintaining human settlements on the Moon and Mars.

Players take on the role of a space habitat engineer and mission commander. They select a mission, choose a landing location, design a habitat and manage essential systems such as power generation, oxygen supply, water recycling, food production and crew health. As the mission progresses, players must balance limited resources, respond to unexpected emergencies and make decisions that affect the survival of the crew.

The game demonstrates how interconnected life-support systems work. For example, a power failure can interrupt oxygen generation and carbon dioxide removal, creating further risks for the crew. Players must understand these connections, identify problems and make informed decisions to keep their habitat operational.

One of the project's key features is its Mission Investigation and Replay System. Instead of simply showing a failure, the game helps players investigate the sequence of events that caused it, understand the consequences of their decisions and replay the same scenario using a different strategy. This encourages experimentation, critical thinking and learning from mistakes.

The project draws inspiration from NASA's planetary exploration research and publicly available space-science resources, including information related to lunar terrain, planetary environments and space weather. Scientific concepts are adapted into simplified educational simulations so that complex engineering challenges are understandable to younger audiences. The game is an educational model, not a real-world spacecraft or habitat control system.

The intended impact is to make space exploration and habitat engineering more accessible and engaging. It encourages students to explore STEM subjects, develop problem-solving skills and understand the scientific and engineering challenges involved in long-duration human space missions.

The project was developed as a web-based application using Google AI Studio and modern web development technologies, with a focus on interactive gameplay, simulation logic, user interface design and browser-based accessibility. It is deployed publicly so that users can access and experience the game through a web browser.

What makes HABITAT ZERO creative is its combination of game-based learning, resource-management simulation and failure investigation. Rather than presenting space science through only text or quizzes, it allows players to experience the consequences of engineering decisions. The design considers scientific plausibility, educational value, age accessibility, gameplay engagement, resource interdependence and the importance of distinguishing real scientific information from simplified game scenarios.

Ultimately, HABITAT ZERO aims to turn the challenge of surviving beyond Earth into an interactive learning experience where every decision matters.
